description:
🚨 MEGAWHEEL ARENA — SPLASH EPISODE 13 🚨
Heavy rain. Three deadly city obstacles. One champion.

At noon in Rainy City, the wet asphalt is slick, the puddles are deep, and the Giant Deep Water Pit is waiting. Siren the Police Car attacks the course first — but the slick concrete wall ends the run in a hard crash. Next, Hydro the Fire Truck charges in with emergency speed and plunges headfirst into the water pit with an epic splash. Then Rocky the Monster Truck rolls up on giant mud tires. Can Rocky conquer the deep water, climb the steep slick hill, and smash through the final barrier to reach the 97m finish?

00:00 Rainy City at Noon — course preview
00:08 Siren the Police Car — slick wall crash
00:24 Hydro the Fire Truck — giant water pit splash
00:40 Rocky the Monster Truck — final run to the trophy
00:56 Finish line at 97m

Who do you think had the craziest outcome? Comment below!
